setting: PRIVILEGED residual learning on a scripted controller: nominal controller planned from simulator object pose; actor observation contains simulator object pose; contacts = GT oracle. NOT autonomous, NOT vision-based.
residual: res1: bounded set-point corrections (fingers +-0.30 rad, wrist position +-2 cm world axes, wrist orientation +-0.15 rad hand axes via quaternion product); scripted phase machine + all controller safety projections unchanged; r = 0 == scripted bit for bit (verification/verification_report.json)
reward: v4r1 unchanged (computed by VisuoGraspV4Env from the executed action)
run: wave2/residual_sac_seed11: SAC, LayerNorm critics, n-step 10, SACConfig defaults (lr 3e-4, batch 256, buffer 1M, learning_starts 10k, ent auto 0.1), actor mean layer zero-initialised, seed 11, approaches top + oblique, max 150,000 env steps, gate at 75,000, 4 torch threads

seeds.model_selection_in_training: 8_000_000+, 50 episodes every 25k (5 per family x approach) -> best_model.zip (key: GT success, then GT any-phalanx, partial-lift rate, mean max lift)
seeds.gate_75k: independent validation 8_500_000+, 100 episodes (50 top, 50 oblique), paired with the zero-residual policy on the same episodes
seeds.final_test: test grid 5_100_000+ (top + oblique, 6 episodes per family/variant/resting-mode cell = 324 episodes per policy), used once after training; never for selection

gate_75k_rule.stop_always: numerical instability (non-finite Q/loss or |Q| > 200 twice) or serious thermal throttling
gate_75k_rule.substantially_worse: paired difference (residual - zero) on all 100 episodes <= -20 pp, or <= -10 pp with exact McNemar p < 0.05
gate_75k_rule.decision: stop if BOTH the 75k gate checkpoint and the in-training best_model are substantially worse; otherwise continue to 150k

final_comparison: scripted controller (base env), zero-residual (residual env), residual SAC best and last, Wave 1 SAC demo best (100k) and scratch best (150k) on the identical test episodes; Wilson CIs, paired McNemar exact + paired bootstrap CI of differences
